contracts.name: R1.1 a failing chain read on GET /verdict answers 502 with the fixed body and no upstream detail
R1.2 any other unexpected error answers 500 with the fixed body and no error text
R1.3 both the 502 and the 500 write the full error to stderr
R1.4 deliberate errors keep their status and message (422, 413, 400)
R2.1 only job-<id>-<hex>.json files count; other job-<id>-* files are ignored even when newer
R2.2 a job with only non-matching files answers 404 like a job with no evidence

task.line: 3. Make `GET /evidence/:jobId` match only `job-<jobId>-<hex>.json`, so other `job-<jobId>-*` files are ignored and a job with only those gets 404 (Req 2.1, 2.2)
